It can also encourage people to be more mindful of their consumption habits, waste, and impact on the environment, leading to a greater sense of responsibility and stewardship. The fact that Ramadan is a recurring experience, happening every year, means that individuals have the opportunity to reflect on their values and priorities annually. This can lead to a continuous process of growth, self-reflection, and refinement, as individuals strive to become better versions of themselves. In many ways, the experience of Ramadan can be seen as a catalyst for personal transformation, encouraging individuals to re-examine their values, priorities, and relationships. By living through this experience every year, people may develop a deeper sense of purpose, compassion, and connection to themselves, their community, and the world around them.
